name: image
description: Image capability — cross-host image generation via Codex's integrated gpt-image tool through the companion bridge. L2 capability plugin per ADR-0010 4-layer composition (ADR-0037). Six cognitive verbs (investigate / frame / decide / compose / critique / refine); generation runs only through Codex's integrated gpt-image (never a direct OpenAI API call), with the Claude host dispatching through the codex-companion bridge and results returned by shared-filesystem path plus text pointer. interface.shortDescription: Cross-host image generation via Codex's integrated gpt-image — frame a brief, generate, critique, refine through the six cognitive verbs
interface.longDescription: L2 capability plugin per ADR-0010 4-layer composition + ADR-0037. Persona-agnostic image-generation capability, reusable by any persona (designer, founder, engineer) and self-serve via its own commands. Exposes the six universal cognitive verbs as canonical skills: investigate (gather visual references, style exemplars, and brand/visual constraints), frame (turn the request into an explicit image brief — subject, composition, style, palette, aspect ratio, output parameters, and success criteria), decide (choose among candidate approaches, styles, or generated variants under the brief), compose (the generative core — generate the image), critique (evaluate a generated image against the brief using vision input), and refine (apply critique/feedback and regenerate). Generation ALWAYS runs through Codex's integrated gpt-image tool (the Responses-API image_generation built-in tool) riding Codex's own auth and wiring — agentic-plugins NEVER calls the OpenAI image API directly (ADR-0037 Alternative 6, rejected outright and out of scope). On Codex the model invokes gpt-image in-session via codex exec; on Claude the codex-companion bridge dispatches and the generated image is written to the shared filesystem, with the companion's text response carrying the artifact path and metadata (no binary channel in companions/contract.md — kept text-only per ADR-0009). Generation parameters are prompt-mediated best-effort (Codex surfaces only the prompt, not structured size/quality/format/background/n). Lean L2 design: no workflow-continuity machinery (no state.mjs / hooks / start macro / meta skills) — brief and result flow through run manifests under .agentic-plugins/runs/image/. A privacy gate genericizes prompts before cross-host dispatch; an honest-scope failure mode reports the limitation when neither native generation nor a reachable Codex bridge exists; and the capability surfaces per-image cost plus the content-moderation gate explicitly (no hidden spend, no blind retry).
defaultPrompt: $image:frame A 1024x1024 hero illustration for a fintech landing page, flat vector style, blue palette
$image:compose Generate the framed image via Codex's integrated gpt-image
$image:critique Evaluate the generated image against the brief
$image:refine Apply the critique findings and regenerate
